articles.title: Khloé Kardashian: "To me, Lamar Odom is dead, all men are liars"
articles.standfirst: Khloé Kardashian burns bridges with Lamar Odom, harshly attacking the man who was once her husband
articles.summary: Khloé Kardashian burns bridges with Lamar Odom, harshly attacking the man who was once her husband
articles.body:
Khloé Kardashian is definitively severing her ties with her ex-husband Lamar Odom, who in the past confessed "I have spent more than 100 million dollars on drugs" and his addiction to women ("I'm a sex addict, I've been with more than 2,000 women" ) .

There are many things that I have found truly distasteful

"I watched the Netflix documentary about Lamar ("Untold: The Death & Life of Lamar Odom"). It doesn’t amuse me at all. While I was watching it, I thought: "Wait a second, I’ve spent some of my time sitting here to do you a favor. I’m not getting paid; I’m doing it simply to be kind". And there are many things that I found really in poor taste", Kim Kardashian’s sister commented on the reality show "The Kardashians" on Hulu .

The documentary recounts the tragedies and difficulties that the former NBA player has faced in his 47 years of life, including his divorce from Kardashian in 2016 and the near-death experience he went through in 2015 after suffering an overdose in a brothel.

You say that in reality you were never in love with me, that you married me only to gain more popularity in pop culture... all that kind of thing, which is very strange

"There was a time when Khloé Kardashian practically had to spoon-feed Lamar Odom to bring him back to life and help him go to the bathroom," says Scott Disick , Kourtney Kardashian's ex-partner.

This only confirms that men are liars, scammers, cheaters, thieves, and trolls. And, quite simply, I want nothing to do with that. Play with yourself, but not with me

Odom claims to have suffered 12 strokes and six heart attacks, managing to defy the medical predictions that indicated he would never walk or speak again.

The Kardashian clan member also revealed on "The Kardashians" that she contracted a staph infection after having "lived in a hospital for four months."

Khloé Kardashian: "I don't need you to thank me, Lamar Odom. Just don't talk about me"

Khloé Kardashian did not hesitate to directly attack the former Baskonia, Lakers, Clippers, Heat and Mavericks player: "You say that you weren't really in love with me, that you married me only to gain more popularity in pop culture... all that kind of thing, which is very strange. Even if that is your truth, why not say it without me being present in these interviews? I found it really regrettable".

I don't need you to thank me, Lamar Odom. Just don't talk about me. Don't try to discredit me," she shared, later stating that "the bridge has been destroyed and there's no rope left to throw to the other side. So, to me, he is dead.

When a producer tried to comfort her, Khloé Kardashian unleashed: "It's okay. I think this only confirms that men are liars, scammers, cheaters, thieves, and trolls. And, quite simply, I don't want anything to do with that. Play with yourself, but not with me."

Lamar Odom: "I wouldn't change my time with Khloé Kardashian, I would only change my actions"

Lamar Odom and Khloé Kardashian got married in 2009 after a courtship of just 30 years .

"It’s a stage I wouldn’t change. The only thing I would probably change would be my actions. But it was part of my story, part of my life; that’s not going to disappear. The only thing I can do now is try to be the best man possible: for myself, for my children (Destiny and Lamar Odom Jr., whom he had with his former fiancée Liza Morales) and for my family," the former player pointed out.

articles.title: NBA Europe advances and predicts franchises worth up to 1 billion: "It will drive incredible investments"
articles.standfirst: Mark Tatum, the NBA's number two, defends the economic potential of NBA Europe and backs a 16-team league with four spots open based on sporting merit.
articles.summary: Mark Tatum, the NBA's number two, defends the economic potential of NBA Europe and backs a 16-team league with four spots open based on sporting merit.
articles.body:
The NBA continues taking steps to establish itself in European basketball, and Mark Tatum , deputy commissioner of the North American league and right-hand man to Adam Silve r, has once again made clear the ambitions of the NBA Europe project, which would arrive on the Old Continent hand in hand with FIBA .

During his speech at the Invest New York event, organized by Sportico, the executive addressed some of the economic and sporting keys to the future competition , which aims to transform the ecosystem of continental basketball and compete directly with the EuroLeague.

The teams that are part of the current ecosystem are, frankly, tired of investing tens of millions of dollars every year without seeing the value of their franchises increase

One of the NBA's main arguments is the economic potential it considers untapped in Europe . Tatum believes there is a huge gap between basketball's popularity, the talent of its players, and the revenue it generates compared with other sports. According to the executive, this situation is causing growing discontent among the owners of Europe's leading clubs.

"The launch of NBA Europe will drive incredible investment in infrastructure

"The teams that are part of the current ecosystem are, frankly, tired of investing tens of millions of dollars every year without seeing the value of their franchises increase. They are looking for a new economic partner," Tatum said.

Franchises worth up to $1 billion in NBA Europe

The NBA maintains its ambition to attract major investments through a franchise model that would allow it to develop new markets and multiply the value of the participating clubs. Tatum expressed confidence that the most valuable franchises in NBA Europe could reach valuations close to $1 billion , a figure that reflects the economic scale of the project.

Expansion into markets with high commercial potential, such as the United Kingdom, currently outside the EuroLeague, is another of the competition's major bets. In addition, another important factor relating to the economic side is the plan for distributing profits and rights to all participating teams.

The teams in the current ecosystem are looking for a new financial partner

The plan also envisages significant investments in sports infrastructure, one of the main shortcomings that the NBA identifies in European basketball. The construction and modernization of arenas capable of hosting major sporting and entertainment events would make it possible to develop new sources of revenue.

"The launch of this league will drive incredible investments in infrastructure. Let's imagine there are between 30 and 40 home basketball nights. That leaves another 320 days to fill those venues with music, concerts, conferences, and other kinds of events," he explained.

The NBA's barb at the EuroLeague: "In essence, it is a closed league"

Beyond economic issues, Tatum also questioned the current functioning of European basketball , marked by the coexistence of the EuroLeague, the Basketball Champions League, the EuroCup and the different national competitions. In the executive's view, this fragmentation creates a complex and poorly connected landscape.

In European sports, they want every club to be able to dream. It is something similar to the beauty of the FA Cup

The NBA had previously explored a possible collaboration with the EuroLeague, but the talks did not bear fruit and, in October, the owners of the clubs in the European competition voted against a potential alliance.

Compared with that model, NBA Europe is proposing, together with FIBA, a 16-team competition, with 12 permanent places and four others open through sporting qualification, offering clubs across the continent the possibility of accessing the new league via the Basketball Champions League and an end-of-season qualifying tournament among the best teams from domestic competitions, thus guaranteeing an open model and the aspirational possibility of participation for all projects.

"In European sport, they want all clubs to be able to dream. It’s something similar to the beauty of the FA Cup" , Tatum explained, invoking the historic English football tournament to defend the importance of keeping the doors of the competition open.

And he concluded with a direct criticism of the EuroLeague system: "Whereas the current model is, in essence, a closed league" .

articles.title: The viral story of the boy who was named after the Knicks title
articles.standfirst: The special meaning behind a baby name inspired by the Knicks' championship
articles.summary: The special meaning behind a baby name inspired by the Knicks' championship
articles.body:
A New York couple has found a memorable way to celebrate the Knicks ’ championship success: by giving their newborn son a name inspired by the team's famous victory chant.

Yvonne Gonzalez-Bradford and her husband, Vance Bradford , welcomed a baby boy named Knickson Fyve Bradford after the Knicks captured the 2026 NBA title . Their unusual naming decision has since attracted attention from basketball fans across the country.

When New York defeated the San Antonio Spurs in Game 5 of the Finals on June 13, ending a 53-year championship drought, celebrations erupted throughout the city. The expectant couple could hear neighbors shouting “Knicks in five,” a phrase that quickly became a rallying cry for supporters.

Yvonne , who was pregnant at the time, suddenly wondered whether those celebrations could inspire her baby's name. She suggested “Knickson” to her husband, who immediately embraced the idea. It was an opportunity for the couple to connect their growing family with a historic moment that meant so much to New York.

“It was in that moment that I was like, ‘Oh, my God, is this just my hormones? Would it be crazy if we named the baby Knickson after the Knicks and this win right now?’” said Yvonne.

The middle name came a little later and carried an additional personal connection for his father.

A name with meaning beyond basketball

Yvonne suggested spelling the number as “Fyve,” completing the reference to the Knicks' five-game Finals triumph. Vance also goes by “V,” the Roman numeral for five, giving the middle name a special connection between father and son.

“My nickname, a lot of people call me V. The Roman numeral for five is V,” said Vance . “So I didn’t get a junior, and I didn’t want a junior, but I do want to have some connection to him in my name, so there it is.”

The Bradfords hope their son's name will remind him to remain determined, overcome challenges and keep pushing forward whenever life becomes difficult.

Yvonne believes the Knicks' journey provides an excellent example of perseverance and resilience. She wants to teach her son about the team's determination and how refusing to give up can eventually lead to success.

“We can talk to him about that perseverance, about keep on going on,” she said.

“It’s such an impactful name. It’s just legendary at this point. [I’m] proud that he can align with New York in that moment and that’s what we can teach him.”

The team's achievement made the naming decision even more special. New York defeated San Antonio 94-90 in the deciding game, with Jalen Brunson scoring 45 points, to secure its first NBA championship since 1973.

After the couple shared their first pictures of Knickson on Instagram, their announcement quickly gained traction online. Basketball supporters and media outlets embraced the newborn, with some affectionately giving him the nickname “the City's nephew.”

Yvonne admitted that seeing so many strangers celebrate her son was an emotional experience. Messages of encouragement, blessings and positive wishes poured in, making the moment even more memorable for the first-time parents.

Vance is particularly excited about showing Knickson the photographs and messages when he's older. He hopes his son will understand how a historic sporting achievement became part of his identity.

articles.title: “Get the facts straight!”: Steph Curry’s mother lashes out at the lies about Ayesha and reveals she turned down roles because of nude and kissing scenes
articles.standfirst: Ayesha Curry gets unwavering support from her husband and mother-in-law amid podcast controversy
articles.summary: Ayesha Curry gets unwavering support from her husband and mother-in-law amid podcast controversy
articles.body:
Sonya Curry has stepped forward to defend her daughter-in-law, Ayesha Curry , after the actress became the subject of criticism over her latest movie appearance.

The controversy erupted following the release of Second Chance Holiday, a Roku romantic comedy starring Ayesha alongside actor Matthew Daddario.

Released on November 5, the movie features a romantic kissing scene between the two actors. However, what should've been another exciting moment in Ayesha's acting career quickly sparked debate among sports fans and podcast personalities.

Former NBA player Gilbert Arenas discussed the scene on an episode of We Said What We Said, where he described Ayesha as the only blemish in the Curry family.

“He [Steph] is the definition of what everybody sees as a father,” Arenas said. “The only blemish in the family is the wife, in the sense, that she doesn’t act like the other superstars’ wives.”

The remarks didn't sit well with Elliott Connie , host of The Elliott Connie Show, who defended Ayesha in an Instagram post. He pointed out that romantic scenes are a normal part of acting and that being married to a superstar athlete shouldn't mean someone has to follow different professional standards.

Sonya appreciated Connie's support but also decided to address the allegations directly, making it clear that she wasn't happy with the claims being circulated about her daughter-in-law.

"Thank youuuu! What's so disturbing is that they justified this podcast on LIES!!!!!" Sonya wrote in the comments section.

"It was a fake kiss, and she hasn’t ever sent a DM to another man! Actually, she’s turned down roles because of the requirement of nudity and kissing!!! Get your facts right before you speak! You will be held accountable!!!"

Steph Curry refuses to stay silent as his wife faces criticism

Ayesha's husband, Golden State Warriors superstar Steph Curry , also broke his silence about the controversy in an Instagram video shared on November 11.

The 12-time NBA All-Star explained that criticism usually doesn't bother either him or his wife, but this particular situation crossed a line. He was especially frustrated by attempts to diminish Ayesha's accomplishments while turning her professional decisions into podcast entertainment.

“Nick, Gil, Emmanuel, and anybody else who feels the need to wanna have to, you know, jump in and give an opinion of something you don’t really know about, something that kinda speaks to a bigger conversation on how you view women in this world and what they’re allowed and what they’re not allowed to do,” said Steph .

The basketball star added that an apology should receive just as much public attention as the original comments.

Meanwhile, Second Chance Holiday continues attracting attention, with the discussion surrounding Ayesha's performance bringing additional interest to the project.

articles.title: Stephen A. Smith addresses the controversy surrounding Ayesha Curry that affects Stephen Curry's entire family
articles.standfirst: The ESPN personality revisited his controversial comments from the 2016 NBA Finals
articles.summary: The ESPN personality revisited his controversial comments from the 2016 NBA Finals
articles.body:
S tephen A. Smith has explained why he refuses to become involved in the latest controversy surrounding Ayesha Curry , admitting that his own history of criticizing Steph Curry ' s wife has influenced his decision to stay out of the debate. The discussion resurfaced after the Golden State Warriors superstar publicly defended Ayesha against criticism of her acting career, particularly following her first leading role in Second Chance Holiday as several former NBA players and commentators had weighed in.

That prompted Steph to challenge those who had made his wife a target and speaking on his YouTube show, Smith praised the four-time NBA champion's character and explained why he believes criticism of his family deserves particular consideration. "There are certain people who come along in life,” Smith said. “That are just so incredibly special as human beings that they should be taken into consideration when you say anything about their family. Steph Curry's one of those people.” He made clear that he had deliberately avoided commenting negatively on Ayesha 's performance, adding that his first consideration would be how his remarks might affect her husband. "I never watched his wife on the Roku show or anything like that,” Smith continued. “I don't know. I had no comments about it. But even if I saw something, I wasn't going to comment. Not in a critical fashion because the first thought that would enter my mind is him."

Stephen A. Smith revisits his controversial 2016 comments

Smith 's explanation came with an acknowledgment that he had previously been involved in criticism directed at Ayesha as during the 2016 NBA Finals , her public reaction to the Warriors ' defeat in Game 6 against the Cleveland Cavaliers became a major talking point. After Steph was ejected for throwing his mouthpiece into the stands, Ayesha posted that the game was "rigged for money" before deleting the message, and the incident sparked widespread debate, including a heated discussion involving Smith on ESPN 's First Take . But Smith now says his comments were intended as advice about protecting the public image of a high-profile athlete, rather than a personal attack. "I wasn't saying a negative word about Steph Curry or her on a personal level. I'm just saying that you're an extension of him," Smith explained as he also compared his argument to the relationship between then-presidential candidate Hillary Clinton and her husband, Bill , insisting that his point was not about gender. He stressed it was about avoiding distractions for someone in the public eye but nevertheless, the comparison between Ayesha and Savannah James attracted considerable backlash and Ayesha herself challenged Smith on social media, asking why he was putting two women against each other. "I've never complained a day in my life," Ayesha wrote in a separate response to the wider criticism surrounding her public comments whilst Steph also defended her at the time, saying: "I don't fault her from showing some emotion on Twitter." Meanwhile, the Warriors have another concern following Curry 's injury against the Houston Rockets as an MRI scan confirmed an oblique abdominal tear, with the team announcing that he would be re-evaluated in two weeks. ESPN 's Shams Charania has reported that his absence could extend closer to a month, leaving Golden State without its leading scorer during a significant stretch of the season.

articles.title: Steph and Ayesha Curry invest $240,000 in 46 school libraries in Oakland amid controversy with Warriors player's wife
articles.standfirst: The pair continue to back young children through their Eat. Learn. Play. Foundation
articles.summary: The pair continue to back young children through their Eat. Learn. Play. Foundation
articles.body:
S teph Curry and his wife are putting $240,000 behind a project designed to help Oakland children find books that reflect their lives, interests and ambitions as their Eat. Learn. Play. Foundation is reshaping school libraries while Ayesha faces renewed scrutiny over comments about motherhood.

The foundation’s Books Kids Want to Read initiative has delivered more than 12,000 books to 46 elementary libraries in Oakland, California as the three-year investment gives librarians greater freedom to choose stories their pupils genuinely want to read, rather than simply increasing the number of titles on shelves.

That approach places children’s interests at the center of library collections, instead of relying on books selected without understanding the students using them, with the aim to make reading more inviting while allowing young people to encounter characters, cultures and experiences that feel familiar and new.

The project is part of a broader literacy effort from the couple as their Little Town Libraries initiative has also sought to make free books easier to access in underserved Oakland neighborhoods, while the latest investment gives schools more freedom to build collections around their pupils.

The foundation highlighted the progress on May 28, 2026, as the program reached its 46-school milestone. Its emphasis on student choice reflects the belief that children can develop a lasting relationship with reading when stories connect with their lives and introduce perspectives beyond them.

How the Currys are making Oakland school libraries more personal

The announcement comes as Ayesha faces a separate wave of online criticism over remarks made during an August 20, 2025 appearance on Alex Cooper ’s Call Her Daddy podcast. And when asked whether she had always wanted a large family, she explained that marriage and children had not been part of her childhood plans. “I didn't want kids. I didn't want to get married. I thought I was going to be a career girl and that's it,” Ayesha said - however, she made clear she would not change the life she has built, adding: “I wouldn't change a thing, of course.” Her comments were originally part of a discussion about how ambitions can evolve as people grow older but after clips resurfaced and attracted criticism, Ayesha challenged the way her comments were being presented. In a post on X.com, formerly known as Twitter, Ayesha hit back as she said: “I've never complained a day in my life. I was asked a question about what I envisioned for myself when I was a LITTLLE GIRL.” The renewed attention followed criticism of her acting ambitions and her role in Second Chance Holiday . Steph and his mother had also defended Ayesha after former athletes commented on her career and life as an NBA player's wife. The podcasters later apologized.

articles.title: Who will step up for the Warriors offensively after Curry’s latest injury?
articles.standfirst: Several players will have an opportunity to establish themselves as leaders during his absence
articles.summary: Several players will have an opportunity to establish themselves as leaders during his absence
articles.body:
The Golden State Warriors have a significant problem on their hands. Stephen Curry, the engine of their offense and the player responsible for keeping the team competitive on a nightly basis, will miss at least two weeks after suffering an oblique abdominal tear. Now, with their superstar sidelined, the Warriors must find other players capable of carrying the scoring load if they want to avoid losing ground in the Western Conference.

The urgency became evident Friday night. Without Curry, Golden State suffered a humiliating 123-85 defeat against the San Antonio Spurs, who extended their winning streak to 11 games and remained unbeaten in NBA Cup play. The Warriors struggled to generate offense throughout the contest, and the 38-point loss exposed just how dependent they have become on their two-time MVP.

Golden State’s only players to reach double figures were L.J. Cryer, who finished with 20 points, and Charles Bassey, who added 11. Meanwhile, Stephon Castle delivered a season-high 32 points for San Antonio , while Victor Wembanyama recorded 12 points and 12 rebounds.

The result was a troubling first indication of what life without Curry could look like. The Warriors will need considerably more production from their supporting cast, and several players will have an opportunity to establish themselves as offensive leaders during his absence.

Who are the Warriors’ best candidates to replace Curry’s production?

Brandin Podziemski is the leading candidate. The guard appears to be one of the most logical players to take on a larger offensive role. The 23-year-old has averaged 16.5 points, 4.9 rebounds and 3.8 assists this season, establishing himself as an important part of Golden State’s rotation.

He has already demonstrated that he can produce when given additional opportunities. On November 9, Podziemski scored 25 points against the New Orleans Pelicans , making five 3-pointers. His ability to create shots, attack the basket and contribute from beyond the arc makes him a natural candidate to assume some of Curry’s responsibilities. The Warriors will need him to become more aggressive offensively rather than simply serving as a complementary player.

Yaxel Lendeborg: An emerging scoring option

Another player Golden State will be counting on is rookie forward Yaxel Lendeborg. The young forward has enjoyed an impressive start to his NBA career, averaging 20.2 points, 7.4 rebounds and 3.5 assists per game through his first 13 appearances.

Lendeborg has already shown that he can handle a considerable offensive workload. He scored 25 points against Houston on November 11, demonstrating his ability to generate offense even against quality opposition.

His versatility could be particularly valuable during Curry’s absence. Lendeborg can score from different areas of the floor, attack mismatches and create opportunities for teammates. If he maintains his current production, he could become Golden State’s second scoring option behind Curry when the superstar eventually returns.

De’Anthony Melton: A valuable opportunity to increase his production

Melton is another player who could benefit from Curry’s absence . The guard is averaging 9.9 points, 4.2 rebounds and 2.4 assists this season, while providing defensive versatility and perimeter shooting. He has already demonstrated his scoring potential, recording 16 points against New Orleans on November 9.

His ability to knock down outside shots and create opportunities off the dribble could help compensate for some of the offensive production Golden State is losing. Melton will need to become more consistent, however, particularly if Steve Kerr expects him to take on a larger role in the rotation.

L.J. Cryer: An opportunity to build on his performance against San Antonio

Cryer might not have entered the season as one of Golden State’s primary scoring options, but his performance against the Spurs offered an encouraging sign. The guard finished with 20 points, becoming the Warriors’ leading scorer in a game when practically nothing worked offensively.

Although his performance was not enough to prevent the blowout, it demonstrated that he can provide an offensive spark when given playing time. Cryer is averaging 6.1 points per game, so maintaining that level of production over an extended period will be a challenge. Nevertheless , the Warriors could benefit from his perimeter shooting and willingness to take shots.

Stephen Curry, the engine of their offense and the player responsible for keeping the team competitive on a nightly basis, will miss at least two weeks after suffering an oblique abdominal tear. Now, with their superstar sidelined, the Warriors must find other players capable of carrying the scoring load if they want to avoid losing ground in the Western Conference.

The urgency became evident Friday night. Without Curry, Golden State suffered a humiliating 123-85 defeat against the San Antonio Spurs, who extended their winning streak to 11 games and remained unbeaten in NBA Cup play. The Warriors struggled to generate offense throughout the contest, and the 38-point loss exposed just how dependent they have become on their two-time MVP.

Golden State’s only players to reach double figures were L.J. Cryer, who finished with 20 points, and Charles Bassey, who added 11. Meanwhile, Stephon Castle delivered a season-high 32 points for San Antonio , while Victor Wembanyama recorded 12 points and 12 rebounds.

He has already demonstrated that he can produce when given additional opportunities. On November 9, Podziemski scored 25 points against the New Orleans Pelicans , making five 3-pointers. His ability to create shots, attack the basket and contribute from beyond the arc makes him a natural candidate to assume some of Curry’s responsibilities. The Warriors will need him to become more aggressive offensively rather than simply serving as a complementary player.

Another player Golden State will be counting on is rookie forward Yaxel Lendeborg. The young forward has enjoyed an impressive start to his NBA career, averaging 20.2 points, 7.4 rebounds and 3.5 assists per game through his first 13 appearances.

Lendeborg has already shown that he can handle a considerable offensive workload. He scored 25 points against Houston on November 11, demonstrating his ability to generate offense even against quality opposition.

articles.title: No answers for Cooper Flagg: LaMelo Ball conducts Timberwolves’ 133-94 demolition of Dallas
articles.summary: The Minnesota Timberwolves delivered a statement performance against the Dallas Mavericks, turning a competitive matchup into a one-sided spectacle with a devastating third-quarter explosion. LaMelo Ball orchestrated the demolition, while rookie forward Cooper Flagg struggled to contain Minnesota’s offensive attack in a 133-94 victory at Target Center. The Timberwolves were simply too much for Dallas. What began as a relatively close contest quickly became a blowout after Minnesota took complete control in the third quarter, exposing the Mavericks’ defensive weaknesses and leaving Flagg with few answers. Minnesota improved to 9-3, extended its winning streak to five games and continued establishing itself as a serious force in the Western Conference.

articles.title: Magic Johnson quietly allocated $325 million to rescue minority-owned businesses that had been abandoned by the big banks
articles.standfirst: Johnson recognized the financial barriers facing minority communities and used his business network to help struggling companies stay afloat
articles.summary: Johnson recognized the financial barriers facing minority communities and used his business network to help struggling companies stay afloat
articles.body:
When the COVID-19 pandemic brought much of America's economy to a standstill in 2020, small businesses faced an immediate fight for survival.

Securing emergency financial assistance was particularly difficult for many Black, Latino and women entrepreneurs, , especially for owners without established relationships with major banks.

Magic Johnson recognized that gap and stepped in to help create another route to funding.

Through EquiTrust Life Insurance Company, majority-owned by Magic Johnson Enterprises, the basketball legend initially committed $100 million to support loans under the federal government's Paycheck Protection Program (PPP).

Working with MBE Capital Partners, the initiative aimed to reach businesses that had struggled to access pandemic relief.

Johnson understood that keeping businesses operating also meant protecting thousands of employees. The funding was designed to help owners cover payroll and other eligible expenses when revenue had collapsed.

Explaining the purpose behind the initiative, Johnson said the assistance would allow businesses to retain employees and "keep their doors open."

The original $100 million commitment was only the beginning. In August 2020, EquiTrust, MBE Capital Partners and Carver Federal Savings Bank announced an additional $225 million in funded PPP loans, bringing the combined total to $325 million.

Johnson's business legacy and his latest Lakers endorsement

The program received more than 21,000 applications, highlighting the demand for financial assistance among businesses that had struggled to secure conventional financing.

Johnson had previously explained that many minority-owned companies in urban communities lacked established relationships with major banks.

“We have to remember that these businesses have been in urban communities for a long time,” Johnson said.

“They’ve been doing great things, and they probably didn’t have a relationship with the banks when the stimulus package went out. So now, we’re able to say, ‘Hey, you can have a relationship with us.'”

His initiative helped provide another lending channel, supporting businesses, nonprofits and religious organizations during an extraordinarily difficult period.

Away from business, Johnson has also been making headlines for his assessment of the Los Angeles Lakers and head coach JJ Redick.

The Lakers have enjoyed an impressive beginning to the 2026-27 campaign, with a 10-2 record following their victory over the Atlanta Hawks. Their six-game winning streak has put them among the leading teams in the Western Conference.

Although Luka Doncic's scoring performances have attracted considerable attention, Johnson believes Redick deserves recognition for his coaching. He has praised the young coach's development, describing him as someone who has "become a great NBA coach."

Redick has faced considerable expectations following an offseason involving nine new players and significant roster changes. Nevertheless, the Lakers have established encouraging chemistry around Doncic and Austin Reaves.

Johnson has also pointed to improvements in the team's mentality and physicality, describing this version of the Lakers as mentally and physically tougher.

With difficult matchups against Western Conference contenders such as the Oklahoma City Thunder and San Antonio Spurs still ahead, maintaining that early momentum won't be easy.

articles.title: LeBron James’ Beverly Hills compound nears completion as the game that made him “King James” comes home
articles.standfirst: New aerial photos show the 2.5-acre estate nearing its final visual stages
articles.summary: New aerial photos show the 2.5-acre estate nearing its final visual stages
articles.body:
F rom above, LeBron James’ Beverly Hills compound looks close to finished. Recent aerial photos show two large residences and a basketball court taking shape on the property. But that is a visual impression, not an official update: the images do not reveal the interiors, confirm that every detail is complete or establish when the family could move in.

The project sits in the Beverly Hills Post Office area, a hillside neighborhood known for private estates and views across Los Angeles. James bought the roughly 2.5-acre property for $36.75 million in 2020. He later demolished the original 1930s home, and construction on the new compound began in 2023 after permits were approved.

Plans reported by Realtor.com call for a two-story main residence of about 16,000 square feet, above a 7,700-square-foot underground garage. The compound also includes a second home of about 6,550 square feet, with a theater and hot-and-cold plunge pools. Other planned features include a pool, spa, outdoor kitchen and a shared motor court.

Where LeBron James’ basketball legacy meets his private world

The court gives the project a personal resonance: it brings the game that shaped James’ life and career into the home he is building. James, a four-time NBA champion and the league’s all-time leading scorer, built his legacy on basketball courts long before this one appeared in the plans.

The scale of the estate is matched by plans for privacy. The two homes are designed to share a secured entrance and a long driveway, with a guardhouse, an alarm system and 10-foot perimeter fencing. The property’s location in the hills also sets it apart from a typical Beverly Hills home.

Lakers legend Magic Johnson has been reported as living in nearby Beverly Park , a separate gated enclave not in James’ compound or on the same street.

LeBron James now plays for the Philadelphia 76ers after spending the previous eight seasons with the Lakers , while his wife, Savannah, and daughter Zhuri remain in Los Angeles, according to the Los Angeles Times.

The latest images suggest the Beverly Hills project is approaching completion from the outside, but no official move-in date has been announced.

For now, the clearest story is the one the photos can show: a private estate taking shape, with a reminder of the game that made “King James.”

articles.title: LeBron James fan shocked by Michael Jordan highlight reel, reigniting GOAT debate
articles.standfirst: There are plenty of younger basketball fans who don't know just how great MJ was.
articles.summary: There are plenty of younger basketball fans who don't know just how great MJ was.
articles.body:
When it comes to the basketball GOAT debate, there are basically two camps: the Michael Jordan contingent and the LeBron James contingent. By most accounts, those who watched MJ play during his prime are never going to have their minds changed. And the younger generation that didn't watch Jordan due to their age are unwilling to retroactively name him the GOAT.

Both players have real cases to sit on the basketball all-time throne. James is arguably a more versatile and efficient offensive player, while Jordan was a stone-cold killer in the playoffs; particularly in the NBA Finals. LeBron's longevity is something to behold as well, although Jordan was no slouch in that regard either.

Michael Jordan was truly a one-of-a-kind player that was "ahead of his time"

As the debate rages on and James nears the end of his NBA career, younger fans are now turning back the clock in order to see if Jordan really was on LeBron's level. One fan in particular took the plunge and came away stunned by a highlight reel of MJ ; which other fans rightfully pointed out didn't even do him full justice.

In the short highlight reel, Jordan cooks defenders with vicious crossovers, sinks mid-range jumpers with ease, dishes out beautiful assists, finishes layups in an acrobatic manner, and dunks on players much bigger than him . The fan couldn't help but exclaim, " this is freakish ".

Jordan was truly a once-in-a-generation player. Many players have tried to copy his style, most notably Kobe Bryant , but no one has been able to fully replicate his impact and ability to change games.

articles.title: Alysa Liu Surprises Everyone with a Stephen Curry T-Shirt and Outshines Caitlin Clark at the Kids' Choice Awards
articles.standfirst: The Olympic figure skating champion attended the Nickelodeon special ceremony wearing a T-shirt featuring the Golden State Warriors star. Her appearance also marked one of the most memorable moments of the awards show.
articles.summary: The Olympic figure skating champion attended the Nickelodeon special ceremony wearing a T-shirt featuring the Golden State Warriors star. Her appearance also marked one of the most memorable moments of the awards show.
articles.body:
Alysa Liu was one of the stars of the 2026 Kids’ Choice Awards , held on Saturday, November 14, in Los Angeles. The American figure skater arrived at the ceremony wearing a Stephen Curry T-shirt—the Golden State Warriors star—but her time on stage ended in a very different way: completely covered in green slime.

The athlete didn’t just attend as a guest. Liu received the Favorite Female Sports Star award, one of the categories at the ceremony organized by Nickelodeon. When she went up to accept the award, she received the traditional slime shower that characterizes these awards and that also drenched other celebrities throughout the night.

Alysa Liu Chose a Stephen Curry Jersey for the Ceremony

Her outfit choice drew attention from the moment she arrived on the orange carpet. Liu wore a Warriors jersey featuring Curry’s name and number 30 —a direct reference to the San Francisco Bay Area NBA team, with which the skater has ties.

The image of the Olympic champion wearing the Golden State point guard’s jersey stood in contrast to the usual gala attire. However, the outfit was short-lived under the circumstances: during the award presentation, Nickelodeon’s signature green slime ended up covering both the athlete and her jersey.

The award she received at the 2026 Kids’ Choice Awards

Liu won in the Best Female Athlete category, where she competed against prominent names in international sports such as A’ja Wilson, Angel Reese, Caitlin Clark, Chloe Kim, Coco Gauff, Mikaela Shiffrin, and Trinity Rodman. The public vote ultimately favored the American skater.

The ceremony was held at Television City in Los Angeles and hosted by Alex Warren. The 2026 edition also featured musical performances and other slime-filled moments, including appearances by Chris Pratt, Ashe, Teyana Taylor, and Jerry Trainor.

The recognition for Liu came after a particularly significant season in her athletic career. The skater became one of the leading figures in American figure skating following her Olympic triumph, and her appearance at the awards expanded her prominence beyond the ice.

articles.title: Who are Brittany Renner and Celina Powell? The "Toxic Twins" scandalizing everyone in the NBA
articles.standfirst: They were in the front row at Clippers vs. Thunder and their presence did not go unnoticed
articles.summary: They were in the front row at Clippers vs. Thunder and their presence did not go unnoticed
articles.body:
The image of the day in the NBA was starred by influencers Brittany Renner and and Celina Powell at the Los Angeles Clippers' Intuit Dome during the game against the Oklahoma City Thunder. The "Toxic Twins" sat courtside to watch the game and caused a stir with their tight black mini dresses.

The reaction of the fans who saw them walking by with a drink in hand toward their seats quickly became something viral on social media, and has given rise to numerous memes . The outfit chosen to go to the game left hardly anything to the imagination.

Brittany Renner and Celina Powell are two American influencers closely linked to the world of sports, hip-hop, and the tabloids.

Renner rose to fame as a fitness model and Instagram influencer. She previously played college football at Jackson State. She has also appeared on Basketball Wives and has a son with P.J. Washington, a player for the Dallas Mavericks.

Powell is an influencer known mainly for her appearances on social media and for publicly talking about alleged relationships or encounters with famous athletes and artists.

Toxic Twins is a new project from Zeus Network that premieres this Monday, November 16 , and their visit to the game could be part of a communication strategy to promote their new show .

In the previous days, both shared promotional material for the show.

articles.title: LA Lakers vs Phoenix Suns: Where to watch today's game and What time is the face off at Footprint Centre
articles.standfirst: Western Conference-leading Lakers visit Suns looking to get back on track at Footprint Centre
articles.summary: Western Conference-leading Lakers visit Suns looking to get back on track at Footprint Centre
articles.body:
This Sunday, November 15, 2026, the Footprint Centre in Phoenix hosts one of those matchups the NBA loves to sell: the Phoenix Suns, still trying to find their best form, against the Los Angeles Lakers, who arrive as the best team in the entire league.

It's the clash between a streaking Western giant and a home team desperately needing points to climb out of the bottom of the Western Conference.

The outlook for Lakers vs. Suns before tip-off

The picture in the standings says it all. The Lakers lead both the Western Conference and the overall NBA standings with a record of 11 wins and 2 losses (.846), the best winning percentage in the league. Their offense is a machine: they have scored 1,588 points, the highest total in the entire competition, with a +103 differential.

Across the way, the Suns are navigating troubled waters. With a 4-6 (.400) record, they sit in third place in the Pacific Division and 19th overall, 5.5 games behind tonight’s opponent. Their point differential is negative (-53), a reflection of a season start that has alternated flashes of promise with hard setbacks.

Two streaks heading in opposite directions

The Lakers come in on a roll. In their most recent outings, they put together a remarkable winning streak: 131-125 against Toronto, a commanding 138-117 over Miami, 116-103 in Sacramento, 121-116 in Detroit, 124-114 in Atlanta and, most recently, a 123-112 road win over Milwaukee.

The only recent blemish was a 129-136 loss to Portland. It's a team that wins both at home and on the road, and that makes it a feared visitor.

Phoenix, on the other hand, has been inconsistent. It is coming off a solid 133-110 win over the Clippers, but before that it had suffered a crushing 96-122 loss to San Antonio on its own court. In the previous stretch it had also accumulated setbacks against Golden State (113-116) and Portland (119-132), interspersed with close wins such as the 102-99 victory over Houston.

The good news for the fans: when the Suns play at Footprint Centre with their best energy, they are capable of beating anyone, as they showed by defeating the Warriors 131-122.

LA Lakers vs Phoenix Suns: Where to watch it live and what time it starts

The game between the Phoenix Suns and the Los Angeles Lakers will be played on Sunday, November 15, 2026 at 4:00 p.m. Eastern Time (3:00 p.m. Central Time and 1:00 p.m. Pacific Time ) at Phoenix's Footprint Centre, which has a capacity of 18,422 fans.

In the United States, the local broadcast will be available on Arizona"s Family 3TV and the Suns Live service in the Phoenix market, while in the Los Angeles market it can be watched on Spectrum Sports Net and its streaming platform Spectrum Sports Net +.

The showdown under the microscope: Los Angeles' artillery against Phoenix's

The biggest appeal is in the backcourts. For the Lakers, Slovenian Luka Dončić is the absolute engine of that league-leading offense, supported by Austin Reaves and Collin Sexton in a deep rotation that also features shooters like Quentin Grimes and defensive specialists like Matisse Thybulle. In the paint, Walker Kessler and veteran Kevon Looney provide presence and rebounding.

The Suns are clinging to their franchise cornerstone Devin Booker, joined by the explosive Jalen Green on the perimeter and the interior duo of Dillon Brooks and Miles Bridges to carry the offensive load.

At the center, Mark Williams and young South Sudanese Khaman Maluach will have the difficult task of containing the opponent's playmaking. For Phoenix, limiting the pace and transition will be key: when the game opens up, the Los Angeles offense punishes without mercy.

What’s at stake in the NBA standings

For the Lakers, the objective is clear: maintain the top spot in the West and in the league. With San Antonio (10-2) and Houston (9-3) right on their heels in the conference, every win matters to preserve the lead and home-court advantage heading into the postseason. A victory in Phoenix would reaffirm their status as favorites.

For the Suns, the game is purely about survival in the standings. 5.5 games behind the tenth spot that marks the play-in zone in the West — currently held by Denver (6-4) — Phoenix cannot afford to lose ground against direct rivals.

Beating a leader like the Lakers would be, in addition to three emotional boosts, a statement of intent that the season still has a long way to go.

The Suns are not yet in an irreversible crisis, but their 19th-place overall standing and losing record place them closer to the bottom of the West than to the play-in spots.

Below them in the Pacific are the Clippers (2-8) and the free-falling Kings (1-10), so the immediate benchmark for Phoenix is to avoid losing touch with the group of chasers. A string of defeats against rivals from their conference could bury them in the trailing pack before November is over.

What is the prediction for Lakers vs Suns?

paragraphs: This Sunday, November 15, 2026, the Footprint Centre in Phoenix hosts one of those matchups the NBA loves to sell: the Phoenix Suns, still trying to find their best form, against the Los Angeles Lakers, who arrive as the best team in the entire league.
It's the clash between a streaking Western giant and a home team desperately needing points to climb out of the bottom of the Western Conference.
The outlook for Lakers vs. Suns before tip-off

The picture in the standings says it all. The Lakers lead both the Western Conference and the overall NBA standings with a record of 11 wins and 2 losses (.846), the best winning percentage in the league. Their offense is a machine: they have scored 1,588 points, the highest total in the entire competition, with a +103 differential.

Across the way, the Suns are navigating troubled waters. With a 4-6 (.400) record, they sit in third place in the Pacific Division and 19th overall, 5.5 games behind tonight’s opponent. Their point differential is negative (-53), a reflection of a season start that has alternated flashes of promise with hard setbacks.
Two streaks heading in opposite directions

The Lakers come in on a roll. In their most recent outings, they put together a remarkable winning streak: 131-125 against Toronto, a commanding 138-117 over Miami, 116-103 in Sacramento, 121-116 in Detroit, 124-114 in Atlanta and, most recently, a 123-112 road win over Milwaukee.
The only recent blemish was a 129-136 loss to Portland. It's a team that wins both at home and on the road, and that makes it a feared visitor.

Phoenix, on the other hand, has been inconsistent. It is coming off a solid 133-110 win over the Clippers, but before that it had suffered a crushing 96-122 loss to San Antonio on its own court. articles.title: Stephen Curry's injury hits the Warriors twice: now they also lose prominence on ESPN
articles.standfirst: ESPN changed its NBA schedule and replaced the Golden State vs. Dallas matchup with an appealing showdown between the Denver Nuggets and the Boston Celtics, with Nikola Jokic as the main attraction.
articles.summary: ESPN changed its NBA schedule and replaced the Golden State vs. Dallas matchup with an appealing showdown between the Denver Nuggets and the Boston Celtics, with Nikola Jokic as the main attraction.
articles.body:
Stephen Curry's injury continues to have consequences for the Golden State Warriors. After losing their biggest star for several weeks, the franchise received another blow: ESPN decided to remove from its national schedule the game it had planned to broadcast between the Warriors and the Dallas Mavericks next November 18.

Instead, the network will bet on the matchup between Nikola Jokic's Denver Nuggets and the Boston Celtics. The change represents a new opportunity for the Serbian's team to take center stage on television.

ESPN's decision that left the Warriors without their national broadcast

The change was announced on November 14. The matchup between Golden State and Dallas, initially scheduled for ESPN, gave way to the game between Denver and Boston, which will be played on Wednesday, November 18 at 9:30 p.m. ET.

The decision also changed the schedule of the Warriors' matchup, moving their game up to 7 p.m. CT. In this way, Nikola Jokic and Jayson Tatum will take center stage in ESPN's national broadcast.

Curry's injury changed Golden State's outlook

The main reason behind this scenario is the absence of Stephen Curry. The point guard suffered a right oblique injury during the game against the Houston Rockets and will have to remain off the courts for several weeks.

The situation was especially exposed in the following game, when Golden State fell 123-85 to the San Antonio Spurs . Without its biggest star, the team showed difficulties finding offensive answers and suffered a crushing defeat.

The Spurs exposed the Warriors' struggles without Curry

San Antonio's team dominated the game from the start and built an 18-0 lead during the opening minutes. By the end of the first quarter, the Spurs were already ahead 38-14 and went into halftime with a 30-point lead : 63-33.

Stephon Castle was the standout player of the game with 32 points, while Victor Wembanyama added 12 points and 12 rebounds. The lead grew to as many as 43 points during the third quarter, on a night when Golden State never found a way to compete on equal terms.

On the Warriors' side, only two players reached double figures in scoring: LJ Cryer, with 20 points, and Charles Bassey, with 11. The rest of the roster had very limited offensive production , a sign of the collective difficulties that emerged in Curry's absence.

Yaxel Lendeborg acknowledged his frustration after the rout

One of the most striking cases was that of Yaxel Lendeborg. The young player, who had scored 25 points against Houston, had a very different performance against San Antonio: he finished with just three points , after making only one of his 13 field goal attempts. He also recorded seven rebounds and a rating of -40.

After the game, the rookie did not hide his frustration and took responsibility for his performance. "It was a horrible performance on my part. I let everyone on this team down", he admitted, according to statements collected by

Lendeborg also left a remark that reflects the emotional impact of the defeat: "I’m not going to get over this". The player explained that he could not remember the last time he had lost by such a margin and acknowledged how difficult it had been to get through the game.

While the Warriors look for solutions to compete without their main star, ESPN has already made a decision about its next national broadcast. The spotlight will be on Denver and Nikola Jokic , while Golden State will have to prove it can regain its level without relying exclusively on Curry.

articles.summary: Kevin Shiflett, an entertainer known as “The Amazing Chin Balancer,” performed a halftime balancing act during the New Orleans Pelicans' home game against the Denver Nuggets on Saturday, November 14, 2026. The game took place at Smoothie King Center in New Orleans, Louisiana, with clips of Shiflett's unusual performance shared on Instagram.
articles.body:
Kevin Shiflett, an entertainer known as “The Amazing Chin Balancer,” performed a halftime balancing act during the New Orleans Pelicans' home game against the Denver Nuggets on Saturday, November 14, 2026. The game took place at Smoothie King Center in New Orleans, Louisiana, with clips of Shiflett's unusual performance shared on Instagram.

Shiflett's act revolves around balancing increasingly challenging objects on his chin, using concentration, coordination and careful body movements to keep them upright. According to the footage description, he introduced one unusual object after another, making each successive trick more elaborate and surprising for spectators. The exact objects used in this particular performance have not been independently verified.

The NBA matchup ended in a 116–108 victory for Denver. Nikola Jokić led the Nuggets with 26 points, eight rebounds and 10 assists, while Jamal Murray added 23 points. Zion Williamson scored 24 for New Orleans, which suffered its sixth consecutive defeat.

articles.title: The warning Luca Doncic received from a former teammate and rival in the Lakers-Suns game
articles.standfirst: Suns guard prepares for a heated reunion with former Lakers teammate
articles.summary: Suns guard prepares for a heated reunion with former Lakers teammate
articles.body:
Jordan Goodwin has no intention of letting familiarity soften his approach when the Phoenix Suns face the Los Angeles Lakers.

The Suns guard knows Luka Doncic after sharing a Lakers locker room with him, but their friendship won't change the assignment if Goodwin is asked to defend one of the NBA's most dangerous scorers.

The matchup arrives as the Lakers visit Phoenix on Sunday, carrying an impressive 11-2 record. Doncic has been key to that start, averaging 38.6 points, 7.5 rebounds and 7.6 assists per game. He leads the league in scoring and has established himself as one of the leading candidates for the Most Valuable Player award.

Goodwin expects the exchange between the former teammates to include some verbal sparring. Speaking to Arizona Republic reporter Duane Rankin, he made clear that any trash talk would remain within the boundaries of competition.

“Me and Luka, we’re real cool. We’re real close,” Goodwin said, recalling their time together in Los Angeles. “We were close when I was in L.A. So, we always talk. We’re going to be talking crazy, but it’s going to be respectful basketball. It’s going to be good bump tomorrow,”

Asked how he would react if Doncic started talking during the game, Goodwin kept his answer simple: “If he starts talking, he starts talking, but we’ll see how the game goes.”

Goodwin plans to rely on his defensive instincts

The Suns guard isn't approaching the challenge as a personal duel, explaining that his preparation will involve studying film, competing hard and defending Doncic as he would any other opponent.

Goodwin understands the problems the Lakers superstar creates. Doncic can score from virtually anywhere on the court, draw fouls and control the pace through his exceptional decision-making. That combination makes containing him difficult, even for defenders who have previously shared a locker room with him.

Goodwin's assignment could be particularly challenging because Doncic has a considerable size advantage, but his defensive numbers offer some encouragement. Goodwin has averaged 1.6 steals per game this season, an impressive contribution for someone who primarily comes off the bench.

His ability to pressure opposing ball-handlers could prove valuable against a player who thrives on controlling possessions.

However, containing Doncic won't be an individual responsibility. Phoenix will need coordinated defensive help, disciplined rotations and consistent communication to prevent him from finding comfortable scoring opportunities.

Giving him too much freedom could quickly become costly, considering the remarkable scoring numbers he's producing.

Doncic has also demonstrated that competitive exchanges can bring out his fiery personality. During the Lakers' 124-114 victory over Atlanta, he reminded Hawks fans that their franchise passed on him in the 2018 NBA Draft, telling the courtside crowd they wished they had selected him.

Goodwin knows exactly what to expect from his former teammate, but he's not promising an all-out war of words. Whether Doncic starts talking or not, the Suns guard intends to make him work for every basket.

articles.title: Charles Barkley recalls his one-day football career while making honest admission about fatherhood
articles.standfirst: Despite achieving enormous success on the basketball court, Barkley admits there's an area of his personal life where he wishes he had done better
articles.summary: Despite achieving enormous success on the basketball court, Barkley admits there's an area of his personal life where he wishes he had done better
articles.body:
Charles Barkley has never hidden his admiration for football, but the NBA legend quickly discovered that watching the sport was considerably more appealing than playing it.

Despite possessing the physical strength and toughness that made him one of basketball's most dominant power forwards, Barkley's brief football experiment ended after just one day.

Speaking on CBS' The NFL Today, Barkley recalled how a coach convinced him to try playing defensive line. However, the experience immediately changed his mind.

“I played football for one day. Then I realized that I was a coward. Football is for grown men,” Barkley explained.

“That’s why it is my favorite sport because you have to be a real man to play football. They put me on a defensive line, and I remember after one practice, as a coach, I just ran into another big old fat dude for two hours straight. That does not take talent.”

He remembered spending an entire practice running into another large player before hearing the coach announce that everyone would return the following day. Barkley wasn't interested in repeating the experience.

He later shared the same story with Shannon Sharpe on Club Shay Shay, joking that his friends continued making fun of him for abandoning football so quickly.

Although Barkley respects the courage required to compete in football, basketball ultimately offered the opportunity he wanted. His physical attributes might have suggested a future on the gridiron, but his basketball development eventually changed everything.

During his junior year at Leeds High School in Alabama, Barkley stood approximately 5-foot-10 and struggled to establish himself in the varsity lineup. However, a remarkable growth spurt during the following summer transformed his prospects.

He eventually reached around 6-foot-4 and developed the imposing build that became a trademark of his NBA career.

His journey took him to Auburn before the Philadelphia 76ers selected him fifth overall in the 1984 NBA Draft. Barkley subsequently became an 11-time All-Star and won the 1993 NBA MVP award.

Barkley admits he fell short as a husband and father

While Barkley's basketball achievements remain unquestionable, the former MVP has been considerably more critical of himself when discussing his personal life.

During his 2024 appearance on Club Shay Shay, Barkley admitted that his responsibilities as a husband and father weren't always handled as well as they should've been.

“I was not a good husband,” he confessed, before describing his daughter as the best thing that had ever happened to him. He also acknowledged that he wanted to become a better person during the next chapter of his life.

Barkley's childhood provides some context for those reflections. His father, Frank , wasn't present while he was growing up in Leeds. Instead, his mother, Charcey , and grandmother, Johnnie Mae , raised him despite financial difficulties. His mother cleaned houses, while his grandmother worked at a meatpacking facility.

Barkley has explained that growing up without an active father figure left him uncertain about how to approach his own responsibilities within a family. He acknowledged that he didn't have a strong example of marriage or fatherhood to follow.

The former NBA star has also experienced public controversies, including a 2008 DUI arrest in Scottsdale, Arizona. He's openly discussed losing millions through gambling, too, demonstrating that his success on the basketball court hasn't always translated into perfect decisions away from it.

articles.title: LeBron James just reached another NBA milestone that only two players have ever achieved
articles.standfirst: With the remainder of this season and a contract for the next one, LeBron could finish second all-time in assists
articles.summary: With the remainder of this season and a contract for the next one, LeBron could finish second all-time in assists
articles.body:
Approaching the first full month of action in the 2026-27 NBA season , five teams have already separated themselves from the pack by surpassing the 10-win mark. In the Western Conference, the San Antonio Spurs (12-2) are riding a blistering 12-game winning streak behind Victor Wembanyam a, who is building an early case to repeat as Defensive Player of the Year while contending for league MVP.

Right alongside them, the Los Angeles Lakers (12-2) have rattled off eight consecutive victories with Luka Doncic averaging an astonishing 37.6 points per game , while the Houston Rockets (11-3) boast a deeply balanced roster led by Kevin Durant , who remains on pace to surpass Kobe Bryant for fourth on the NBA’s all-time scoring list before the season concludes.

Over in the East, the Jayson Tatum -led Boston Celtics (11-2) have barely missed a beat despite losing Jaylen Brown this past offseason, meanwhile, Brown has teamed up with LeBron James and Tyrese Maxey to propel the Philadelphia 76ers (11-3) to an electric start. While plenty of basketball remains on the calendar, these five contenders have completely dominated the opening month of the campaign.

LeBron James Surpasses Jason Kidd to Reach Third All-Time in NBA Assists

Boasting arguably the most star-studded roster on paper, Philadelphia’s combination of Brown’s explosive athleticism and James’ unmatched basketball IQ has lived up to every bit of the super-team hype.

For James, nearly every night on the hardwood brings another historic milestone. During Sunday afternoon’s 131-124 victory over the Indiana Pacers , James tallied 15 points and a season-high 11 assists , officially passing Hall of Famer Jason Kidd to claim third place on the NBA’s all-time career assists list with 12,092 .

Now trailing only John Stockton (15,806) and Chris Paul (12,552) , James joins an exclusive club as just the third player in league history to eclipse that mark.

Already cemented as the NBA’s all-time leading scorer with 43,606 career points and counting, James still has another year left on his contract, giving him a realistic shot at catching Paul for second place in assists, even if Stockton’s monumental record remains virtually untouchable for anyone in basketball history.

Having already secured more regular-season victories and points than any player to ever step on an NBA court, James’ sole focus in Philadelphia is capturing a fifth championship ring to tie legends like Kobe Bryant, Tim Duncan, and Magic Johnson .

The Sixers won’t have much time to celebrate the milestone, however, as they travel up the turnpike to New York to face the Brooklyn Nets on Monday night.

articles.body:
Through the opening month of the 2026-27 NBA season , the Los Angeles Lakers and San Antonio Spurs have separated themselves as the top two teams in the association, both boasting 12-2 records .

Both Western Conference powerhouses are riding massive momentum, with San Antonio owning a 12-game winning streak behind Victor Wembanyama , who is building an early case to repeat as Defensive Player of the Year while contending for league MVP.

Meanwhile, Los Angeles has rattled off eight straight victories led by Luka Doncic , who tops the NBA in scoring at an astonishing 39 points per game , pouring in 40 or more points in seven of his first 12 starts.

On pace to repeat as scoring champion and claim his third scoring crown in four seasons, the 27-year-old superstar stands as the early frontrunner for MVP, though individual hardware remains secondary to capturing his first career NBA championship.

Bronny James Faces Diminishing NBA Minutes in Los Angeles

While the Lakers thrive atop the standings, one of the most recognizable names on the roster, Bronny James , continues struggling to earn playing time in head coach JJ Redick’s rotation .

Now in his third professional campaign, the 22-year-old guard has spent much of the fall shuttling between the NBA and the G League , a familiar pattern across his young career. Beyond Los Angeles’ red-hot start, James faces a daunting logjam in the backcourt.

With Luka Doncic, Austin Reaves, Collin Sexton, Quentin Grimes, Jaden Hardy, and Matisse Thybulle all healthy and commanding regular rotation minutes, there is virtually no room left on the perimeter depth chart.

James has logged garbage-time action in six NBA games so far this season, averaging just 2.8 minutes per contest while recording 1.3 points and zero rebounds or assists .

Even more glaring is his minus-40 net rating across 16 minutes and 35 seconds on the floor, meaning the Lakers have been outscored by 40 points during his brief stints on the court. With numbers like that, cracking Redick’s nightly lineup becomes nearly impossible.

What about full G League for Bronny James?

Consequently, James appears destined to spend the bulk of the winter in the developmental ranks, just as he did during his first two seasons. In his lone G League appearance thus far with the newly relocated Coachella Valley Lakers , he looked far more comfortable, tallying 22 points, four rebounds, and seven assists to lead the squad to a victory.

At this stage, James finds himself caught in an awkward basketball limbo, looking overqualified for the G League yet overwhelmed by the speed and physicality of the NBA.

With minimal opportunities available on a title contender, his long-term outlook in Los Angeles looks increasingly uncertain and leans toward an eventual departure.

articles.title: Who is Da’monte Khiree Greene, the American basketball player arrested at the Lagos airport after 34 kilograms of cannabis were found in his luggage?
articles.standfirst: The Thailand-based basketball player was arrested at Lagos airport after investigators reportedly uncovered cannabis parcels and a tracking device
articles.summary: The Thailand-based basketball player was arrested at Lagos airport after investigators reportedly uncovered cannabis parcels and a tracking device
articles.body:
American basketball player Greene Da’monte Khiree has been arrested in Nigeria after anti-narcotics officers allegedly discovered 33.95 kilograms of cannabis in two suitcases at Lagos’ international airport.

The 28-year-old, from Savannah, Georgia, is now at the centre of a drug-trafficking investigation that could carry serious legal consequences.

Nigeria’s National Drug Law Enforcement Agency (NDLEA) said Khiree arrived at Murtala Muhammed International Airport on November 11 aboard an Emirates flight from Thailand via Dubai. Officers reportedly acted on intelligence and monitored his movements after he landed.

According to the agency, Khiree abandoned two checked suitcases and attempted to leave the airport carrying only his hand luggage. Officers arrested him in the airport car park before searching the abandoned bags.

The search uncovered 32 parcels of “Loud”, a particularly potent form of cannabis, with 16 parcels packed inside each suitcase. The combined weight was 33.95 kilograms, equivalent to approximately 75 pounds.

Investigators also recovered a tracking device and luggage identification tags bearing information linked to the suspect.

The NDLEA said Khiree told investigators he'd been living in Thailand since October 2025 and had travelled to Nigeria on holiday to establish professional connections for his basketball career.

However, a forensic examination of his mobile phone allegedly revealed information suggesting he knew about and was involved in the suspected trafficking operation. These allegations haven't been tested in court.

Greene’s basketball career

Basketball records show Khiree as a point guard from Savannah, Georgia. His college career began at Reinhardt University, where he redshirted during the 2017-18 season before moving to South Georgia Technical College, where he played for part of a season.

He subsequently developed his career through semi-professional basketball in the United States. During the 2023-24 campaign, he emerged as the leading scorer for the Georgia Bombers, averaging an impressive 26.3 points per game, according to the Basketball Job Market.

His basketball ambitions eventually took him overseas, where he continued playing in Thailand. Khiree represented the Buriram Boars during the 2025-26 season before joining Fully Feared BC.

He also appeared on the roster of the Pattani Raptors in Thailand's Premier Men's League. His most recent reported appearance came on November 7, when the Raptors suffered a 102-81 defeat against the Buriram Broncos.

Nigeria maintains strict laws against cannabis possession and trafficking, with drug trafficking potentially carrying a life sentence. However, the specific charges against Khiree and the next steps in his case haven't been confirmed in the available reports.

His arrest also recalls other high-profile cases involving basketball players detained overseas for cannabis-related offences. Former college player Jarred Shaw was arrested in Indonesia after authorities intercepted cannabis-infused gummies sent to his apartment.

WNBA star Brittney Griner was detained in Russia in 2022 over cannabis oil before being released in a prisoner exchange.

articles.title: Jayson Tatum clearly hasn’t forgotten about Steve Kerr’s ‘suspicious’ Olympic benching
articles.standfirst: The Celtics superstar hasn't forgotten his limited role in Paris, and his latest comments suggest the Olympic controversy still bothers him
articles.summary: The Celtics superstar hasn't forgotten his limited role in Paris, and his latest comments suggest the Olympic controversy still bothers him
articles.body:
Jayson Tatum’s latest comments have reopened an Olympic chapter he clearly hasn’t put behind him.

The Boston Celtics forward has revealed that Steve Kerr’s decision to limit his role during the United States’ gold-medal run at the 2024 Paris Games left him questioning what was happening.

Speaking on the Boardroom podcast, Tatum recalled Kerr approaching him before a game after Kevin Durant returned from an absence during the exhibition schedule. Kerr reportedly told him the coaching staff would need to adjust the lineup and urged him to be patient.

“Steve like, he came to me before we got on the bus to go to the game. Because I remember KD was out for the exhibition games in the early rounds then he came back,” Tatum said as per NBA Courtside on X.

“And I remember Steve was like, you know, Kevin is back, so we’re going to have to try to figure something out with the lineup. He was like, just be patient. Like, what the f**k does that mean?.

“Like why you telling me that? And then I remember sitting on the bench and I think it was like once I didn’t get in the first quarter, I was like, ‘Oh, some fishy s**t going on,’.”

The debate followed Team USA throughout the tournament. Tatum , then one of the NBA’s leading young stars, didn’t receive the consistent opportunities many expected. He was left out of the rotation for two games, despite the Americans’ considerable depth and star power.

Tatum’s Olympic frustration remains part of the story

Kerr had to manage a roster packed with established stars, with limited minutes available and different combinations required from game to game. The United States ultimately won gold, but the team’s success didn’t erase questions about how certain players were used.

Some observers speculated that Tatum’s difficult 2022 NBA Finals against Kerr’s Golden State Warriors may have influenced the coach’s choices.

There’s no evidence that this played a role, however, and Tatum hasn’t identified whose minutes he believed should have gone to him.

The comments also arrive during a strong stretch for Boston. The Celtics moved to 11-2 after routing the Dallas Mavericks 131-94, with Tatum continuing to produce at a high level. He’s averaging 26.8 points, 7.3 assists and 6.1 rebounds, although his shooting percentages remain below his previous standards.

That dip may have a straightforward explanation. Tatum said after Sunday’s win that he doesn’t yet feel fully recovered from the Achilles injury that sidelined him.

He returned on March 6, 2026, and believes the research he’s reviewed suggests many players need about 12 months after returning before they feel like themselves again.

Tatum’s comments on the Olympics suggests the experience still carries an emotional edge for the Celtics star.

articles.body:
Ben Wallace made a name for himself by dominating the paint, protecting the rim and helping the Detroit Pistons become NBA champions.

Now, the Basketball Hall of Famer is making headlines for something far removed from the court: his impressive Virginia estate, which has hit the real estate market with a $6.9 million asking price.

The former Pistons center and his wife, Chanda, originally purchased 35 acres of land in Goochland County, Virginia, for $790,000 before building a spectacular 22,308-square-foot mansion.

The property, located in Manakin-Sabot near Richmond, features an indoor basketball court, a swimming pool, a private gym and enough garage space for at least 13 vehicles.

articles.title: Stephen Curry on his retirement: "I assumed it would probably be the last contract I signed, but maybe..."
articles.standfirst: Curry has spent his entire NBA career with the Golden State Warriors, and he has no plans of playing for another team before retiring.
articles.summary: Curry has spent his entire NBA career with the Golden State Warriors, and he has no plans of playing for another team before retiring.
articles.body:
In a way, LeBron James has spoiled many basketball fans. It's not normal for a player to still be so effective and productive into his 40s. But not enough people seem to be talking about Stephen Curry doing similar things at 38 years old for a Golden State Warriors team that remains competitive and relevant.

Curry obviously isn't the same player he used to be. He's playing the fewest minutes per game of his career, which should theoretically be affecting his output. Yet through 10 games this season, he's shooting what would be a career-high 45.7% from three-point range and scoring the most points per game (27.8) since 2022-23 . Only time will tell if those numbers hold over the course of the season, but he remains an elite scoring threat.

Curry's performances have been a breath of fresh air for the Warriors, who handed him a massive two-year extension right before the season. Like he always has, Curry is repaying them so far . There were legitimate rumors linking Curry to a move away from the Warriors in the offseason. Ultimately, Curry decided to stay with the franchise that drafted him - and possibly lock himself into an entire NBA career played in the Bay Area .

Stephen Curry admits his current Warriors contract could be his final one, but he's leaving the door open

A recent article from ESPN's Anthony Slater went in-depth on Curry's decision to re-sign with the Warriors. In it, Curry makes a surprising admission, yet kept open the door for a potential extending of his career after his current contract runs out.

The decision, Curry said, was about clarity for everyone involved, eliminating distractions and still earning his financial worth as a player while providing an extra boost of flexibility for a franchise he intends to be with through his 20th -- and possibly final -- season. "All of it," Curry said. "I assumed that it would probably be one of, if not the last, contract I signed. I'm not afraid to say it. But maybe I'll surprise myself and want to keep going." If circumstances demanded it, Curry said he would've been fine sliding into more of a complementary role late in his career, similar to most fading stars. Perhaps he eventually will. "It would not kill my ego," Curry said. "I want to win. Whatever that means, you make decisions based on what's in front of you."

Curry appears ready to call it quits after this contract expires. But if he still feels good, and feels he can contribute to a team, he's open to continue playing - ideally for the Warriors.
